onboarding.screen1Body: Split bills with friends, roommates, or travel companions. Personal spends stay encrypted on this device — no contacts, SMS, or location.
onboarding.screen2Title: Log spends in 3 taps or less
onboarding.screen2Body: Quick-Tap categories, snap a receipt, or speak an expense. Built for hostel life and tight schedules.
onboarding.screen3Body: Equal, custom, or percentage splits with auto debt simplification. Create an account only when you need shared ledgers.

home.emptyBody: Tap a category above to log your first spend in PKR.
home.onTrackBody: Spending is within your monthly budget. Keep it up!

auth.loginHint: Sign in to start tracking your group expenses.
auth.registerHint: Create an account for shared hostel and mess ledgers.
auth.legal: By continuing, you agree to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
auth.displayNameTooShort: Display name must be at least 2 characters.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
auth.serverUnreachableLocal: Sign in needs the HisabKitab cloud API. This install still points at localhost, which does not work on a phone. Personal expenses work without signing in.
auth.serverUnreachable: Cannot reach the HisabKitab server ({{url}}). Check your internet connection, or set the API URL in Settings.

groups.title: Groups
groups.hint: Invite roommates with a code — we never read your contacts.
groups.name: Group name
groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one or join with a roommate's code.

ocr.title: Snap & Log
ocr.privacy: Receipts are read on this device with ML Kit. Images are never uploaded. We delete the photo after parsing unless you choose to keep it.
ocr.limitBody: Please try again in a moment.
ocr.nativeBody: Receipt scanning isn’t available on this install. You can still add the expense manually.
ocr.failedBody: Try a clearer photo or enter the expense manually. Nothing was uploaded.
ocr.cameraDeniedBody: HisabKitab only uses the camera to scan receipts on your phone. We won't ask again. You can still pick a photo from your gallery.
ocr.galleryDeniedBody: Allow photo access only to select a receipt image. Processing stays on device.
ocr.tryGallery: Tip: use Choose from gallery instead.
ocr.confirmHint: We auto-picked a category from the receipt when possible. Edit anything that looks wrong, then save.
ocr.keepImageHint: Off by default. Image stays only on this phone.
ocr.willDelete: Photo will be deleted after you save.

dashboard.title: Budget
dashboard.chartEmpty: Log a few expenses to see charts here.
dashboard.pieA11y: Pie chart of spending by category
dashboard.tagAnalyticsEmpty: Add tags on manual expenses (e.g. hostel, mess) to see totals here.
dashboard.categoryLimitsHint: Optional: set a limit on a category below after you have spending.
dashboard.alert80: You've used 80% of this month's budget. This alert stays on your device.
dashboard.alert100: You've reached 100% of this month's budget. This alert stays on your device.
dashboard.notifPrivacy: We'll ask once for local notifications at 80% and 100%. If you decline, we won't ask again.

voice.title: Voice entry
voice.privacy: Voice uses your phone’s speech service. Prefer offline when available; you can also type the phrase.
voice.privacyOnDevice: On-device speech is available on this phone. Audio is processed locally when possible.
voice.examples: Try: “Spent 200 on lunch” or “Paid 150 rupees for chai”.
voice.confirmHint: Edit anything that looks wrong, then save. Source will be marked as voice.
voice.micDeniedBody: HisabKitab only uses the mic for expense phrases. We won't ask again. You can still use Quick-Tap, Snap, or Manual.
voice.onDeviceTitle: Mic listening unavailable on this phone
voice.onDeviceBody: Speech recognition isn’t available here. Type a phrase below, or use Quick-Tap / Snap / Manual.
voice.typeFallbackLabel: Or type what you would say
voice.nativeBody: Microphone voice entry isn’t available on this install. You can still type a phrase below.
voice.failedBody: Try again in a quieter place, or enter the expense manually. Nothing was uploaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.allFreeBanner: Everything is free — PDF, unlimited OCR, unlimited groups, and tag analytics.
settings.limitsUnlimited: OCR unlimited · Groups unlimited · PDF · Tag analytics
settings.lockNeedPin: Enter a PIN below to enable lock.
settings.themeHint: Tap the sun / moon switch to change theme.
settings.categoryHint: Custom categories show up in Quick-Tap and when logging expenses. Nothing is capped.
settings.apiUrlHint: HTTPS URL for sign-in and hostel groups. Personal expenses stay on this phone.
settings.deleteAccountBody: Clears local login tokens. Server account deletion can be requested from support once the API is live.
settings.deleteDataBody: This permanently erases expenses, budgets, and local group cache on this device.
